rows: - Removed: `clis/workflow-cli/src` (all 120 TypeScript files), `bundle/wf.js` (1.7 MB), the 90 unit tests and fakes that exercised that code, and the two e2e tests whose only subject was the TypeScript worker. `legacy()` is replaced by a refusal: an unknown command gets commander's `error: unknown command 'x'` (exit 1), a known command given arguments no port serves gets `wf <cmd>: the Rust wf does not support these arguments (see wf <cmd> --help)` (exit 2). The help tests now check the committed texts against the binary instead of regenerating them from the commander tree.
